intent_record.intent_summary: Fix potential use-after-free race condition by caching runtime fields before releasing stream lock
intent_record.what: Cached runtime fields (no_period_wakeup, rate, buffer_size) into local variables before releasing stream lock, then used cached values instead of direct runtime-> field accesses after unlock
intent_record.how: Prevents use-after-free by ensuring runtime data is captured while holding the lock, allowing safe access after snd_pcm_stream_unlock_irq() when a concurrent close() may have freed the runtime structure

vuln_statements.explanation: This statement initiates iteration through linked streams without acquiring a reference count on each stream's snd_pcm_runtime structure. Combined with the subsequent access to s->runtime fields (not fully shown), this allows concurrent close() operations to free the runtime memory while it's still being dereferenced, causing use-after-free. The group reference obtained via snd_pcm_stream_group_ref() does not protect individual stream runtime structures from being freed.
